summary: Runs sequential mini-equations over POP attributes in one node. Each Combine block chooses an operation, Scope A/B/C operands, and a Result Scope, with support for constants, components, uniforms, multiple inputs, and length-mismatch handling.

key_concepts: series of math operations in one node
simpler version of Math Combine POP
common_gotchas: Secondary input attributes are auto-named with prefixes such as in1_, so use those names in Scope A/B/C instead of assuming original names.
single-point inputs are treated as constant values and can be combined with multi-point POPs.
Math Mix uses the primitives and vertices of the first input; other inputs' primitives and vertices are ignored.
Attach an Info DAT to inspect the raw GLSL code generated by the Math Mix POP.
Use official sequential-block parameter names such as comb0scopea and comb0result, not shorthand display labels like scopea or resultscope.
For mismatched point counts, choose length mismatch notification and action deliberately instead of letting the node warn, error, or align unexpectedly.
